summary: Audit of agent behaviour based on provided excerpts. One major violation found for verification: the agent initiated an order action (setting up a return) before the account was pulled up/verified. No violations for personal data, promises, escalation or conduct.

findings.quote: Okay. Let's set up that return then. I will need your email and order ID.
findings.explanation: The agent begins by saying they will set up the return (an account/order action) before the account is shown as pulled up. System logs show 'Purchase validation in progress ...' only at turn 14, after the order ID is provided in turn 13. Policy requires the agent to pull up the account (full name or account ID) before any account or order action; doing the action or confirming it before verification is a major violation.

findings.quote: Alright, now I will need your membership level.
findings.explanation: The agent requests membership level after the system indicates purchase validation began (turn 14) and after the customer provided the order ID (turn 13). However, the initial action to 'set up that return' was already stated in turn 8 before verification occurred. The sequence shows the agent proceeded with the return process without first pulling up the account, violating the requirement for verification prior to order actions.
